methods_proposed.name: Logistic Regression
methods_proposed.description: Simple linear classifier using all available features
methods_proposed.implementation_code:
def predict_logistic_regression(train_df, test_df, target_col, **params):
    from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
    from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score

    X_train = train_df.drop(columns=[target_col])
    y_train = train_df[target_col]
    X_test = test_df.drop(columns=[target_col])

    model = LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000)
    model.fit(X_train, y_train)
    predictions = model.predict(X_test)
    return pd.DataFrame({'predicted': predictions}, index=test_df.index)

def predict_decision_tree(train_df, test_df, target_col, **params):
    from sklearn.tree import DecisionTreeClassifier

    X_train = train_df.drop(columns=[target_col])
    y_train = train_df[target_col]
    X_test = test_df.drop(columns=[target_col])

    model = DecisionTreeClassifier(max_depth=5)
    model.fit(X_train, y_train)
    predictions = model.predict(X_test)
    return pd.DataFrame({'predicted': predictions}, index=test_df.index)

def predict_random_forest(train_df, test_df, target_col, **params):
    from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier

    X_train = train_df.drop(columns=[target_col])
    y_train = train_df[target_col]
    X_test = test_df.drop(columns=[target_col])

    model = RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=100, random_state=42)
    model.fit(X_train, y_train)
    predictions = model.predict(X_test)
    return pd.DataFrame({'predicted': predictions}, index=test_df.index)
